jobs.description: Dreaming of a job where you don't have to rise early? As an afternoon shift mail sorter at PostNL, this dream can become a reality. You start your work in the afternoon, allowing you ample time for other activities! As a team member in the sorting center, you'll be sorting mail with your friendly colleagues, but PostNL doesn't expect you to be limited to just sorting. There are plenty of other work possibilities available through discussion! Does a gross hourly salary of €14.99, travel reimbursement, and free training opportunities sound appealing to you? Read on and apply today!Manpower agency is looking for a Postal Worker for PostNL in the Zeist region, with the exact work location being Nieuwegein.As a mail sorter, your primary task is, of course, sorting mail! This is done using a sorting machine. Additionally, there are various other work opportunities at PostNL. Are you inclined towards administrative tasks, or do you prefer getting physically involved? Through discussion, there are always options to take on different tasks!What you'll get:    - Gross hourly salary of €14.99     - Travel reimbursement according to the PostNL collective labor agreement    - Gain logistics experience at a reputable company    - Work within a pleasant, friendly, and motivating team    - On-the-job training and the opportunity to be trained for multiple machines    - Part-time job of fifteen hours per week    - Free access to over two hundred training courses via Manpower Academy    - Minimum age of eighteen    - Ability to work standing and lift heavier containers    - Proficient in Dutch and/or English for communication and safety instructions    - Availability for a minimum of three shifts per week    - A VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct) if required    - Personal transportation to commute to the workplaceLastly, it would be beneficial if you live in (or near) Zeist, Nieuwegein, Utrecht, or Maarssen.If you meet the requirements and are enthusiastic, don't wait
